header: One tick per period, each typed by an editor
lead: A published record rather than a monitor. Each tick is filled to the figure typed on its period and coloured by the semantic key beside it, because at the availabilities anyone actually reports every tick looks full.
note: State the period and the reporting date in the note, and keep the strip under about 31 ticks. Any period an editor wrote a sentence about is repeated underneath, so an incident is never hidden by the strip that contains it.

metrics.title: Period 3
metrics.text: A period with a sentence on it appears again below the strip, with the sentence.

metrics.title: Period 5
metrics.text: Three keys are honoured: normal, degraded and down.
